TORSINAL PENDULUM.
Determination of moment of inertia of disc using Torsional Pendulum.

COMPOUND PENDULUM.
Determination of moment of inertia of rigid rod about center of mass- Compound Pendulum.

SURFACE TENSION.
Determination of Surface Tension of liquid by Capillary rise method.

STOKES METHOD
Determination of coefficient of Viscosity of highly viscous liquid by Stokes method.

SONOMETER
Determination of frequency of tuning fork -  Sonometer.

WHEATSTONE BRIDGE.
Determination of the resistance and resistivity of a given coil – Wheatstone Bridge.

LAW OF RESISTANCE.
Verification of laws of resistances – Ohm’s Law.

JOULE’S CALORIMETER
Determination of specific heat capacity of liquid - Joule’s Calorimeter.
